sonnet.problem: The joke mentions 'the Millers' carving my name into my handle' without saying who the Millers are. Bakers may not know his backstory, so the line has to explain it itself, for example by saying the family who owned him carved his name.
sonnet.rule: Bakers may not know anything about his story. Anything from his backstory, like the drawer, the Millers, the shiny new stamper or the angel, is said in the line itself
